title: Brisbane hospital outbuilding transformed into A$4.45M home
summary_full: Sold for A$4.45 million, a remarkable five-bedroom home at 24 Brisbane Street in Annerley sets a new local record. The property's past as a hospital outbuilding is complemented by Ric DeLuca's innovative renovations, showcasing a striking sawtooth roof and preserving its historical essence. The residence boasts spacious living areas and a separate guest wing, reflecting the growing interest in character-filled homes with a story.
